title: Rafflesia ssx & asx
identity: The exact Billaudot GB5479 title is Rafflesia, du prélude à l’épilogue (2e/3e mouvements), associated in catalog metadata with B-flat and E-flat saxophone and piano. This does not match the catalog note’s soprano/alto duet description. A Philharmonie reference guide clarifies the related three-movement saxophone/orchestra work, but does not identify the saxophone/piano GB5479 edition.

evidence.claim: Official Billaudot catalog lists GB5479 as Rafflesia, du prélude à l’épilogue (2nd/3rd movements), under saxophone B-flat, and shows B-flat saxophone/piano and E-flat saxophone/piano classifications.
A retailer describes the GB5479 issue as soprano and alto saxophone with piano, but does not provide a readable score. This conflicts with a duet interpretation and needs edition confirmation.
Billaudot lists Prélude à rafflesia, GB4860, as a separate 1990 solo alto saxophone work of four pages. Keep it distinct from GB5479.
A university repository’s repertoire guide indexes Prélude à Rafflesia (1990) by Claude Pichaureau as solo alto saxophone, distinct from the cataloged GB5479 title.
The guide distinguishes solo alto Prélude, a soprano/orchestra second movement, and alto/orchestra Epilogue within the 15-minute work.
evidence.source_name: Claude Delangle et al., 10 ans avec le saxophone (Philharmonie de Paris digital scan)

collection_flag: Original contemporary saxophone work. Current instrument/ensemble metadata in the catalog may conflate separate B-flat/E-flat score versions with a duo; clarify before making a fit judgment.

gaps: Readable GB5479 score and exact mapping of its second/third movements to B-flat/E-flat instruments are unavailable.
Confirm whether the catalog entry intends a saxophone-and-piano version, a duet, or both separate saxophone editions.
proposed_corrections: Review title and instrument fields against the official GB5479 score: publisher catalog describes the 2nd/3rd movements with B-flat and E-flat saxophone/piano classifications, not explicitly a soprano-and-alto duet. Do not change catalog until score mapping is verified.

The wider Rafflesia title family includes the three-movement saxophone/orchestra work described in the 1993 reference guide. Keep this distinct from the cataloged GB5479 piano edition until its cover and score clarify the intended version.
